note: v2 amends v1 after autoresearch_v1 was read. Two deviations, both found in v1's lockbox: (1) v1 set the NEW floor by (asks + in-catalog NEWs), which counts an ASK and a wrong NEW the same, so it sent 22% of D2 lines to NEW although top-1 was 99.6% right there; v2 sets the floor by expected taps. (2) v1 had no latency constraint and picked a shortlist with E in it at 17 ms/line on the search machine; v2 drops shortlists over maxShortlistMsPerLine. v1's lockbox has been read, so v2 draws a new one.
farDefinition: wrong AUTO lines / all lines, as in the bake-off

dev.select: test side (already read by bakeoff_v3; it is a dev set here, not a holdout)

lockbox.note: D1 cannot be regenerated, so it is not in the lockbox. Gate thresholds are the ones fitted on dev calibration, transferred unchanged.

searchSpace.stage2: coordinate ascent on the weights, step 0.05, from the 3 best stage-1 configs, until no step improves the objective
searchSpace.gate: G1 with sAuto, mMin, agreeMin chosen by Learn-then-Test fixed-sequence testing on calibration (binomial tail p-value, Bonferroni over paths); sFloor then minimizes expected taps per line (tapCost)

objective: maximize correct AUTO lines / lines on the dev test side, subject to the dev test side's one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound on FAR <= farMax
tieBreak: expected taps per line on dev test
lockboxReport: R4 as in bakeoff_v3 with its own G1 tuner
maxShortlistNote: Proxy for the plan's 15 ms p95 on a low-end Android device, assuming that device is about 3x slower than the search machine. Unmeasured assumption.
